meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 会去查 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先用 search 返回带 ID 的结果表,再看 timeline 上下文,只对筛出的 ID 取完整详情,必要时才调原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问「这个之前是不是解决过」「上次是怎么做 X 的」等关于以往会话的问题时触发;当前对话内的问题不走它。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前有没有修过认证相关的问题
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的搜索结果表

say.text: 查一下上周这个项目都发生了什么
say.note: 按日期范围搜索观察记录

say.text: 上次迁移失败的原始命令输出是什么
say.note: 先读摘要,不够再取原始工具输出

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: search returns an ID index, timeline adds context, full details are fetched only for the IDs you keep, and raw tool I/O only if summaries fall short.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?" — not questions about the current conversation.

say_en.text: Search whether we already fixed anything about authentication
say_en.note: Returns an ID index table first

say_en.text: What happened in this project last week?
What was the exact output of the migration that failed?
say_en.note: Summary first, raw tool output only if needed
